claim_text: Fleischman said that the reported/video-shared attack on a Palestinian on Jerusalem Day was fake.
discovery_sources: The Seventh Eye 2024 Channel 14 report; Channel 13 Election Zone capture published 2023-06-18; Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post contemporaneous Jerusalem Day reporting; renewed targeted Hebrew/English Channel 14/YouTube archive recheck 2026-09-02
resolution_notes: The Seventh Eye preserves the exact quote and attributes it to Fleischman / The Patriots / June 2023. Independent contemporaneous reporting documents multiple assaults on Palestinians and journalists during the May 18 Jerusalem Day march, including video and police arrests, strengthening the counter-evidence lane. But the exact original Channel 14 broadcast/date is still unrecovered and the wording does not uniquely identify which assault Fleischman meant. Selecting one would be guesswork, so no adverse verdict is forced.
media_status: Original Channel 14 segment remains unrecovered/Blocked. Exact incident footage exists for several Jerusalem Day assaults, but none can safely be attached to this claim until the referenced assault is uniquely identified; no substitute imagery used.
